subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose update execution to gateway-authenticated HTTP callers, and if so should it be a new endpoint or an Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The request expands host package-update and restart authority from existing Gateway control-plane paths to an HTTP surface, so maintainer intent is needed for auth scope, private ingress, audit/rate-limit behavior, target-version support, and failure-mode guarantees.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep the version metadata decision in the narrower open issue and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

options.title: Expose through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `update.run` or a narrow wrapper to the disabled-by-default Admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit trusted-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, handoff, and target-version proof requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep the version metadata decision in the narrower open issue and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest shared history across Admin HTTP RPC, version resolution, and the current Gateway update surface.
